open_items: [Done] Real Module 02 forecasts ingested (full 30,490 / 4 windows): lightgbm reads period directly, and the cumulative quantiles of the three baselines are constructed in this module from the "cumulative error quantiles of earlier windows"; for window 1913 the WAPE/MASE of the four models match the values M2 itself reports digit for digit, and realised coverage is in coverage_report.csv

[Done · coverage] After the baseline cumulative quantiles switched to the error-additive method (S = point forecast + τ quantile of the cumulative error from earlier windows), realised coverage at τ=0.95 is ets 0.941, lightgbm 0.923, seasonal_naive 0.937, tsb 0.943, with order quantities broadly level with actual demand; the discarded conventions (daily residual resampling 0.76–0.80, pooled z 0.77, per-series block difference 0.62, z×σ restoration 0.96–0.98) are all recorded in simulation_parameters.json for the audit trail

[Done] Switch to the full 30,490: M2's full L12 four-window daily/period/residuals, 322 MB, was downloaded and ingested, with the calibration windows 1745/1773/1801 reused; for the full 1913 window the four models' WAPE/MASE match M2's full metrics digit for digit

[Done] The Module 03 panel is in place: point forecasts are self-consistent (top level equals the leaf sum), while the 28-day cumulative quantiles are unreconciled and store-level quantiles are systematically high. Accuracy metrics are therefore reported at sku/store/total level; cost, coverage and the decision map stop at sku level, with the supplement's high-level quantile calibration and order granularity comparison as corroboration at store and total level.

[Done] Hierarchy node conventions: the Module 03 handoff package has 42,840 nodes / 365,880 membership relations / 30,490 leaves, consistent with this module

[Done · self-check] The sample is all 30,490 series of the M5 dataset (CA 4 / TX 3 / WI 3 stores, truth files checked store by store)

[Done · grid extension] The τ grid was extended from 20 points (0.80–0.99) down to 23 points (0.50 / 0.667 / 0.833 taken from M2's native period τ, with no new delivery requirement on M2): the measured optimum for 1:1 moves from the boundary 0.80 to 0.50 and for 2:1 from 0.80 to 0.667, both with a deviation of 0.000 from the theoretical q*=Cu/(Cu+Co); the optima for 5:1 and 9:1 (0.86, 0.92) were already inside the grid and are unchanged. The main-table cost, WAPE/MASE and bootstrap at headline τ=0.95 are digit-for-digit identical to the 20-point version.

[Done · two convention checks] Equal-coverage cost (crosscheck_equal_coverage.csv) and select τ on validation → report on test (tau_selection.csv): the former corrects the 0.923–0.943 coverage differences between the four models, the latter ensures the selection does not happen in the test period (Module 01 README, line 113).
